<thought>We need the number of methyl groups in the molecule. The available tools can provide the 1H NMR spectrum for the sample, which should include signals for methyl protons (typically around 0.8‑1.2 ppm) with integration values corresponding to three protons per methyl group. By examining the spectrum and summing the integrations of all methyl signals, we can determine the total count of methyl groups. I will request the proton NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
